reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE)
), grid AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with a budget
  SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, COALESCE(m.spend_eur, 0) AS spend_eur
  FROM budget_monthly b
  LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.channel_id = b.channel_id AND m.month = b.month
  WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-01'
)
SELECT channel_id, month, spend_eur,
  spend_eur - LAG(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month) AS change_eur
FROM grid

SELECT g.channel_id, g.month, g.spend_eur, g.spend_eur - p.spend_eur AS change_eur
FROM grid g
LEFT JOIN grid p ON p.channel_id = g.channel_id AND p.month = g.month - INTERVAL 1 MONTH

solver.query: WITH sp AS (SELECT c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur FROM ad_spend_daily a JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND a.spend_date <= DATE '2025-10-31' GROUP BY 1, 2), b AS (SELECT bm.channel_id, bm.month, COALESCE(sp.spend_eur, 0) AS spend_eur FROM budget_monthly bm LEFT JOIN sp ON sp.channel_id = bm.channel_id AND sp.month = bm.month WHERE bm.month >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND bm.month <= DATE '2025-10-01') SELECT channel_id, month, spend_eur, spend_eur - LAG(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month) AS change_eur FROM b
